failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of acetonitrile exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 40°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Inadequate photon penetration due to fouling or misalignment
failure_modes.mitigation: Regularly clean and align light source; monitor photon flux
Implement regular maintenance and inspection schedule

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Perform light source alignment check and photon flux measurement every 24 hours
Conduct BPR valve functionality test under full flow conditions weekly
